newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fedex starts expanding Anchorage hub.
newsitem.headline: Fedex starts expanding Anchorage hub.

text.p: Federal Express Corporation has started building a $38 million expansion of its Anchorage hub which will improve the flow of air cargo between Asia and the United States.

As volumes continue to rise, the sort and clear operation in Anchorage is beginning to reach peak capacity, Fedex said in a statement. Since the hub's first full year of operation in 1990, average daily volume has grown by more than 300 per cent.
"We will be able to handle more packages and do it better, faster and more reliably than ever before," Denny Bird, managing director of national sort operations in Anchorage said.

Fedex said it currently services the Asia Pacific market with 4,100 employees serving more than 30 countries and territories providing the most extensive trans-Pacific air lift of any major competitor. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
